text:
Maya K: Heads up — seeing ~400 leads drop into the Unassigned queue in the last 4h. Handoff SLA alert tripped. Looks related to the enrichment webhook
Darren W: Can you paste a sample? Is owner blank or the HS owner id failing to map to SF?
Maya K: sample export: {
  contactId: 00123,
  hs_owner_id: null,
  enrichment_status: success,
  last_enriched_at: 2026-03-21T08:12:00Z
}
Maya K: enrichment succeeded but owner cleared during last workflow step. Might be our new "normalize_company" step that rewrites owner if domain match fails
routing-bot: :warning: handoff-sla | 400 unassigned leads detected in marketing-inbound. SLA breach window: 45m
Darren W: Ok. Two likely paths: 1) HubSpot workflow accidentally clears owner when company normalization returns no match. 2) HS->SF sync mapping rejects owner IDs not present in SF and we drop ownership.
Leo C: Also saw skew in the rotation logic yesterday — owners with 0 recent claims are getting skipped until TTL, which can cause bursts of unclaimed leads. We should add a fallback claim to the unassigned queue instead of leaving blank
AJ: I can push a quick workflow patch in HS: change the "set owner" step to only set if {{hs_owner_id}} exists else call a webhook to push into the "fallback-claim" queue. Test in staging first.
Darren W: Good. For SF sync, let's add defensive mapping: if owner id doesn't exist in SF, map to the sales-ops fallback user (sales_ops_user@redwood) instead of null. I can open the PR.
Maya K: sales asked for canary timing — they want a low-volume window. Any preference?
sales-ops-bot: sales-ops ready window: 14:00-15:00 PST tomorrow. Please notify #sales during canary.
Leo C: Also propose a small change to round-robin: use claim_count in last 7d rather than last 24h to avoid temporary starvation. That should smooth bursts.
AJ: I'll implement HS workflow change + webhook for fallback queue. Steps:
1) create workflow clone -> modify "set owner" conditional
2) add webhook endpoint: POST /lead-fallback with payload {lead_id, source, enrichment_ts}
3) add a small lambda to immediately attempt assignment via rotation algorithm against staging pool
4) smoke test with 50 synthetic leads
Darren W: I'll draft the SF mapping PR and add a DB migration that defaults owner to sales_ops_fallback when mapping fails. Will include tests.
Maya K: plan sounds good. Can everyone drop sync updates here? I'll notify sales and escalate if counts don't drop within 2h of canary.
AJ: started staging run now with 50 test leads -> 50/50 assigned to staging owners. Posting logs: `curl -XPOST https://staging-webhook/lead-fallback -d '{"lead_id":"t-001","source":"test"}'`
Darren W: PR opened: github.com/redwood/sync/compare/hs-fallback-1799 -> please review.
Leo C: I'll tweak rotation config after we see staging claim distribution.
Maya K: thanks team. follow-ups: AJ will roll to prod after staging ✅, Darren will merge SF fallback mapping, Leo will update rotation window, I'll confirm with sales post canary. :thumbsup:
